Name: Terra Fish
Author: Axophy
Description:
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][size=4] [/size][size=3]Terra Fish has added 64+ special fish from [b][url=https://www.terraria.org/]Terraria[/url][/b], including 8 legendary fish. [/size][/center]
[center][size=3] [/size][/center]
[center][size=3]All of these fish can be put into fish pond for products or into aquarium as decoration,[/size][/center]
[center][size=3]some of them have their unique pond products or special aquarium animation. [/size][/center]
[center][size=3] [/size][/center]
[center][size=3]These fish can be found in places where the variety of fish is limited, [/size][/center]
[center][size=3](such as desert, volcano, sewer, secret woods .etc )[/size][/center]
[center][size=3]to enrich the existing fishing game experience.[/size][/center]
[center][size=3] [/size][/center]
[center][size=3]In addition, many useful things related to these fish have been added,[/size][/center]
[center][size=3]including weapons, potions, artisan goods, and so on.[/size][/center]
[center][size=3] [/size][/center]
[center][size=3]Even if you've never played [i]Terraria[/i], you can still have a blast with it![/size][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][b][size=3]Requirements:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url],  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17746]Buff Framework[/url] and  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42603]Moby Dick[/url] [/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=3]All original sprites and sounds are from the Official Terraria Wiki and Official Calamity Mod Wiki.[/size][/center]
[left][line]
[/left]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/MxxBf87V/New-Objects.png[/img][/center]
[center][spoiler][left][color=#ffffff][b]Weapons[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]Rock Hammerfish: club, randomly scatters 6 gravels during the attack, 35 - 45 projectile damage, exchanged at Adventurer's Guild after reaching underground mine 20 level.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Frost Daggerfish: ranged weapon , 60 projectile damage, shoots 1 bullet and release a ice crystal at once, small scattering angle, exchanged at Adventurer's Guild after reaching underground mine 60 level.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Bladetongue: ranged weapon, 16 - 24 projectile damage, shoots 6 infinite bouncing bullets at once, 360 degrees scattering angle, exchanged at Krobus Shop.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Toxikarp: ranged weapon, 45 - 60 projectile damage, shoots 5 bullets at once, large scattering angle, exchanged at Krobus Shop.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Obsidian Swordfish: ranged weapon , 70 - 85 projectile damage, shoots 3 bullets at once, middium scattering angle, exchanged at the Volcano Dungeon Shop .[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Crystal Serpent: ranged weapon, 200 projectile damage, shoots 1 bullet at once slowly, small scattering angle, exchanged at the Volcano Dungeon Shop.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Archerfish: ranged weapon, 20 - 35 projectile damage, shoots 10 bullet at once fastly, middium scattering angle, exchanged at the Island Trader. [/color][/*]
[/list][center][color=#ffffff][size=4][b]ATTENTION : NPCs or pets being hit by a projectile will reduce friendship points![/b][/size] [/color][/center]
[color=#ffffff]
[b]Crates[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]Found at beach, can be pried open by blacksmith, contains a variety of resources and foods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Including 4 types: copper, iron, gold, and iridium. The higher the crate level, the higher the fishing level required.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]You can enable catching crates or not when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff]
[b]Potions
[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]Wrath Potion: increase attack, recipe can be purchased at Adventurer's Guild.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Rage Potion: increase critical chance, recipe can be purchased at Adventurer's Guild. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Endurance Potion: increase defense, recipe can be purchased at Dwarf Shop.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Cursed Flames Flask: Significantly increase attack and critical power, while reducing a small amount of luck, recipe can be purchased at Krobus Shop.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Ichor Flask: Significantly increase attack and weapon speed, while reducing a small amount of defense, recipe can be purchased at Krobus Shop. [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#ffffff]
[b] Artisan Goods
[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#ffffff]Shrimpy Truffle : producted by Duke Fishron, can be used to make Shrimpy Truffle Oil.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Scaly Truffle : producted by Fishotron, can be used to make Scaly Truffle Oil. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffffff]Superheated Blood : producted by Lava Shark, can be used to brew Blood Champagne.[/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[/spoiler]
[/center]
